**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Derive the new API fixtures from captured producer output**

The new pagination tests construct the GraphQL response entirely with `jq -n`, without a captured response or a producer run tying its field set and pagination metadata to GitHub's output. Consequently, they demonstrate agreement between the mock and parser rather than validating the external response contract. `docs/review/tests.md` explicitly requires fixtures from real producer output and says to flag hand-built shapes; commit a sanitized captured response and derive the resolved/unresolved page variants from it. The same requirement applies to the new hand-built pr-verify responses.
